highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Free e-government platform that serves two billion people in ten countries has critical SQL injection bug and New GeoServer RCE exploit chain seen in the wild two days after disclosure. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Microsoft: Hackers in China, N Korea using ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
